items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: So Zutty and I, we're going out here with Dave Payton.

ctx.x: Ben Pollitt. So he had this job to going out there following Ben Pollitt. So he had contacted me, Earl, Louie, and Zutty. We were supposed to go in there together with the rest of the band to make up the band. So last minute different things come up. Louie had offered to go with Clarence Jones at the Metropolitan Theater. So Louie went there, and Earl went someplace else. So Zutty and I, we're going out here with Dave Payton. But that was the end of that deal with Louie's band. And of course, I think it was…
Was that still the district up there?
